caption:
O you who have believed, persevere and endure and remain stationed and fear Allah that you may be successful.

Surah Aal-i-Imraan (3:200). Swipe through for the Arabic, then English, Mandarin, Korean, Japanese, Malay, Thai and Spanish.

Sources on the final slide.

#Quran #Sabr #Patience #Taqwa #IslamicReminder #Deen

sourcing.primary_text: Qur'an 3:200, Surah Aal-i-Imraan. Not used by any prior post (checked against all existing blankdiscussions meta.json files). Standing 8-language/10-slide format.
sourcing.arabic: Edition quran-uthmani, live call api.alquran.cloud/v1/ayah/3:200/editions/quran-uthmani,en.sahih,zh.jian,ko.korean,ja.japanese,ms.basmeih,th.thai,es.cortes (HTTP 200, fetched 2026-10-11); fetched twice in the same script and the two responses diffed identical; slide text written programmatically from the raw API fields, no retyping.
sourcing.other_editions: en.sahih (Saheeh International), zh.jian (Ma Jian), ms.basmeih (Abdullah Muhammad Basmeih), th.thai (King Fahad Quran Complex), es.cortes (Julio Cortes): same call, byte-identical. ko.korean and ja.japanese: translator listed as unknown by source, slide says 'Translator not specified by source'.
sourcing.source_artifact_note: Artifact scan found no double spaces, leading/trailing whitespace or control chars in any edition. th.thai has a space before '!' (position 25), which is ordinary Thai typographic convention in the source, not an artifact; left byte-identical, no wording touched.
sourcing.verification_note: Live fetch in the build script (two fetches diffed identical) plus a third independent re-fetch later the same session diffed against every slide JSON: all 8 texts byte-identical. No wording from memory.
sourcing.compliance_check: Checked against 142 string terms in compliance-policy.json halal section across all edition text: 0 hits.

theme_note: All prior themes used; new theme 'dune-indigo' added for this post.

hosting_verified.note: Visually spot-checked Arabic, Chinese, Korean, Thai slides: no tofu or missing glyphs.
